# E-Way Easy

E-Way Easy is an Android app for GST-registered traders, manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors and transporters in India. It creates a GST invoice or imports an invoice PDF, lets the user review the details, and files the e-way bill on the official NIC e-way bill system from a phone. The website also has a free online invoice generator (with or without GST), free Excel invoice formats, free GST tools and plain-English guides on e-way bills and GST invoices.

## Key facts

- Platform: Android only, available on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ewayeasy.app). There is no iPhone app. No download, user or rating figures are published.
- Pricing: pay-as-you-go wallet credits. 1 credit = ₹1 (Rs 1). Each e-way bill action costs 5 credits, which is ₹5 (Rs 5). No yearly subscription.
- Making invoices in the app is free. Credits are used only for e-way bill actions.
- Actions that use credits: generate, update Part B (vehicle), consolidated e-way bill, cancel, extend validity.
- Credit packs: 50 credits (₹50), 100 credits (₹100), 250 credits (₹250), 500 credits (₹500), 1,000 credits (₹1,000), or any other amount.
- Credits are taken only when an action succeeds. If the portal rejects it, they return to the wallet automatically.
- Payment: inside the app through Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking). Purchased credits are not refundable; if a payment goes through but credits are not added, the credits are added or the payment is refunded.
- Filing route: e-way bills are filed on the official NIC e-way bill system (ewaybillgst.gov.in) through an authorised GST Suvidha Provider (GSP), using the user's own e-way bill API login. That login is stored encrypted and used only for the bills the user asks for.
- Independence: E-Way Easy is a private product. It is not a government portal and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of India, GSTN or NIC.
- Founder: Meet Akabari. Guides and blog articles are written by Bhavesh Akabari.

## What the app does

- Generate an e-way bill from a GST invoice created in the app.
- Import an invoice PDF: the app reads the buyer, GSTIN, items, HSN codes and totals, and the user must review them before generating.
- Fill buyer details from the GSTIN, HSN codes from saved products, and road distance from PIN codes.
- Support Bill To / Ship To and Dispatch From details.
- Update Part B and vehicle number, extend validity, cancel, and create consolidated e-way bills.
- Download the e-way bill PDF and share it on WhatsApp or email, or print it.
- Save buyers, products, transporters and vehicles.

## Free invoice generator (website)

- URL: https://ewayeasy.in/invoice-generator. Free, no sign-up, no watermark, no invoice limit. Works in any browser.
- Two modes: With GST (tax invoice with GSTIN, HSN, place of supply, CGST + SGST for same-state sales or IGST for inter-state sales) and Without GST (simple bill for sellers not registered under GST). Link https://ewayeasy.in/invoice-generator#without-gst opens the non-GST bill.
- Calculates line totals, discounts, tax, round-off and the amount in words (Indian format) automatically. Keeps an invoice number series, saved products and drafts in the browser only. Downloads a PDF or prints (A4, A5, Letter, Legal).
- Invoice data is processed in the browser and is not uploaded to any server.
- Buyer auto-fill from GSTIN and road distance from PIN codes are app features, not part of the web generator.
- Excel formats: https://ewayeasy.in/invoice-format-excel offers a GST invoice format and a bill format without GST (.xlsx) with tax formulas built in.

## What the app does not do

- No bulk e-way bill generation and no bulk upload of many PDFs at once.
- No e-invoice (IRN) generation.
- No multi-user or team accounts.
- No full accounting.
- The free website tools help prepare and check data. They do not generate e-way bills.
